facts.value: Candidates can apply to the University of Limerick through the Central Applications Office (CAO).
Qualified candidates to all undergraduate degree courses are placed in order of merit based on a points system.
Applicants must be at least 16 years of age on the 15th of January of the year of entry.
A special application must be made to the University via the Admissions Appeals Process for candidates below 16 years of age.
For course-specific entry requirements, please see the relevant course page.
Applicants must hold an established Leaving Certificate (or an approved equivalent) with a minimum of six subjects, including two H5 grades and four O6 or H7 grades.
Applicants must hold an established Leaving Certificate (or an approved equivalent) with a minimum of five subjects, including five O6 grades or five H7 grades.
